svg.title: Lasutriv — Mission Control banner
svg.desc: Lasutriv. ROLE: Game developer · autonomous AI agents. LATEST: Monarchy · New Roots. ASSET: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code 24/7. A flight console: a mission clock counts up, three stations report GO, and a spacecraft circles an orbit above a planet.
